notes.title: Lover Interface launches on 2025/10/03! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]The BL visual novel [i]Lover Interface[/i] will be officially released on [b]October 3rd, 2025[/b] on Steam.[/h2][p][/p][h3]The full version includes:
✨ Complete romance routes with multiple endings
✨ New CGs and story events
✨ The long-awaited reveal of the “special slot” from the demo[/h3][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: October 3rd, 2025
💻 Platform: Steam (Windows)
💬 Languages: Traditional Chinese, English[/p][p][/p][h3]Add the game to your wishlist now to be notified at launch!
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3366940" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff809f"]👉 Lover Interface[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Lover Interface Demo 1.0.4 Update Notice
notes.content: [h1][/h1][list][*][p]Replaced background music tracks that previously triggered YouTube Content ID claims. You should now be able to record or stream the game freely without copyright warnings or monetization issues. If any problems persist, feel free to report them.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and omissions in both Traditional Chinese and English text.  [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted several visual assets. [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone who downloaded the demo and provided feedback — your support is incredibly valuable in improving the overall experience.[/p][p]If you have any further suggestions or issues with version 1.0.4, feel free to reach out.[/p][p]Please look forward to the full release.[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 The Lover Interface demo is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 The Lover Interface demo is now live on Steam![/h1]
[h2]The free demo of the BL visual novel Lover Interface is now officially available on Steam![/h2]

In the demo, you'll experience the beginning of Ethan Syu’s story after he unexpectedly gains a love interest “interface” and meets several characters for the first time.
Feel free to try it out, stream it, and share your thoughts—your feedback is invaluable to us.
And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to support future development!

notes.title: Lover Interface Demo Coming on May 15, 2025!
notes.content:
Hello, this is MuYou.
[h1]The free demo of BL visual novel Lover Interface will be released on May 15, 2025 (CST) on Steam![/h1]
[h2]In the demo, you’ll experience the beginning of the story, where the protagonist Ethan Syu unexpectedly gains access to an affection interface and has his first interactions with several key characters.[/h2]
[h3]Welcome to try the demo, share your thoughts, and stream your gameplay! Your feedback will help shape the continued development of the game.[/h3]
Thank you again for your support, and don’t forget to add Lover Interface to your wishlist!
